meta.name: meta-ads
meta.description: Manage Meta Ads (Facebook + Instagram) — performance, ROAS, CPM, frequency, audience overlap, learning phase, creative fatigue, budgets, ad sets, campaigns, ads. Use for any mention of Meta Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, ROAS, CPM, ad spend, or campaign settings on Meta.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Meta 广告投放,优化效果与预算
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在运营 Facebook 或 Instagram 广告
copy.tagline_en: Manage Meta ad campaigns and optimize performance and spend
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Facebook or Instagram ads

howto.what: 接入 Meta 广告数据后，Claude 会分析你在 Facebook/Instagram 的广告表现（如花费、ROAS、CPM），发现素材疲劳、学习受限、受众重叠等问题，并建议暂停或调预算；实际改动前先给你看预期影响、等你确认。它还会保存历次表现基线，以便之后发现异常。
howto.when: 当对话里出现“Meta 广告”“Facebook 广告”“Instagram 广告”等 Meta 投放词或指标，或提出查看/调整这些广告的需求时触发。

say.text: 看看最近 7 天的广告表现：ROAS、频率和点击率怎么样？
say.note: Claude 会拉取数据并指出需要留意的变化。

say.text: 有个广告组一直学习受限，帮我判断该合并还是换优化目标？
say.note: 它会按学习阶段规则给出处理建议。

say.text: 如果把某广告组预算提高 20%，会有什么影响？
say.note: 它只先做分析，不会未经确认就改动。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews Facebook/Instagram ads, spots creative fatigue, learning issues or audience overlap, and suggests budget/pause changes after showing expected impact and getting your OK. It maintains a rolling baseline for anomaly detection.
howto.when_en: Triggered by mentions of Meta Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, ROAS, CPM, ad spend, or campaign settings; also by requests to review performance, pause campaigns, or update budgets.

say_en.text: Review my ads over the last 7 days: ROAS, frequency and CTR?
say_en.note: Pulls data and points out what changed.

say_en.text: Ad set stuck in Learning Limited: consolidate or change the event?
What if I raise one ad set's budget by 20%?
say_en.note: Analyzes first; no change without your say-so.
